parameters.query:
SELECT
  a.*,
  b.ID_Item_Monday AS ID_Item_Monday,
  b.Nombre AS Nombre_Monday,
  c.`tour virtual` AS tour_virtual,
  c.`my photo` AS my_photo,
  c.`my photo cate` AS my_photo_cate,
  c.`default` AS default_label,
  c.`no aplica` AS no_aplica
FROM input1 a
LEFT JOIN input2 b
  ON LOWER(TRIM(a.`ID Venue`)) = LOWER(TRIM(b.`ID_Venue`))
CROSS JOIN input3 c
